The patrol pressure event appears only as detached complication text. Canon requires an unusually quick welfare-check/search interaction focused on Michelle's research, followed by the unnoticed-until-after reflective tape marker. None of that is narrated to the player as lived scene content.

Protected knowledge boundaries are respected; the failure is underdelivery, skipped beats, weak responsiveness, and inconsistency with the specific local evidence and pacing.
